# Recording pill (`recording-pill`)

Floating recording status with timer and live waveform.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createRecordingPill` (types in `dist/web/feedback/recordingPill.d.ts`): `.mh-recording-pill` (`--floating --top | --bottom`, `.is-recording | .is-paused`): recording status with a pulsing dot, a `role="timer"` clock, a live waveform and optional pause and stop buttons. Parts `__dot`, `__status` (visually hidden, announced on change), `__timer`, `__wave`, `__bar`, `__pause`, `__stop`.

```ts
export function createRecordingPill(options: RecordingPillOptions = {}): RecordingPillHandle;

export interface RecordingPillOptions {
  /** Seconds recorded so far (default 0). */
  elapsed?: number;
  paused?: boolean;
  /** Count up once a second while not paused (default true). Off: the timer only changes through `setElapsed`. */
  ticking?: boolean;
  /** Input level, 0–1; each new level adds a bar to the waveform. */
  level?: number;
  /** Name of the pill and its status while recording; default "Recording". */
  label?: string;
  /** Status while paused; default "Paused". */
  pausedLabel?: string;
  /** Float over the screen at the top or bottom centre instead of sitting in the flow. */
  floating?: RecordingPillPlacement;
  /** Shows a pause / resume button. */
  onPauseToggle?: (paused: boolean) => void;
  pauseLabel?: string;
  resumeLabel?: string;
  /** Shows a stop button. */
  onStop?: () => void;
  stopLabel?: string;
}

export interface RecordingPillHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  readonly elapsed: number;
  setElapsed(seconds: number): void;
  setPaused(paused: boolean): void;
  setLevel(level: number): void;
  /** Stops the internal clock. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createRecordingPill, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' }, 'Recording');

// Stands in for the microphone's input level (0–1).
const levels = setInterval(() => pill.setLevel(Math.random()), 120);

const pill = createRecordingPill({
  onPauseToggle: (paused) => (status.textContent = paused ? 'Paused' : 'Recording'),
  onStop: () => {
    clearInterval(levels);
    status.textContent = `Saved a ${pill.elapsed} second note`;
    pill.destroy();
    pill.el.remove();
  },
});

document.body.append(pill.el, status);
```

`RecordingPill` (types in `dist/react/feedback.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createRecordingPill`. `paused` is controlled by the parent through `onPauseToggle`.

  label?: string;

  floating?: RecordingPillPlacement;

  onPauseToggle?: (paused: boolean) => void;

  onStop?: () => void;

}

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { RecordingPill } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function RecordingPillExample() {
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(true);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!recording || paused) return;
    // Stands in for the microphone's input level (0–1).
    const timer = setInterval(() => setLevel(Math.random()), 120);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [recording, paused]);
  if (!recording) return <p aria-live="polite">Note saved</p>;
  return (
    <>
      <RecordingPill level={level} paused={paused} onPauseToggle={setPaused} onStop={() => setRecording(false)} />
      <p aria-live="polite">{paused ? 'Paused' : 'Recording'}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```
